signIn.title: Investor sign-in
signIn.intro: Enter your email address and password to open the investor hall.
signIn.error: That email address and password do not match.
signIn.tooManyAttempts: Too many attempts. Wait a moment and try again.
signIn.unexpected: Something went wrong. Try again in a moment.

setPassword.title: Choose your password
setPassword.intro: Set the password you will use to sign in to the investor hall.
setPassword.hint: At least 12 characters, and not a common password.
setPassword.tooCommon: That password is too common. Choose a less predictable one.
setPassword.mismatch: The two passwords do not match.
setPassword.expiredBody: It may have been used already, or it has expired. Ask your administrator for a new invitation, or request another reset.
setPassword.unexpected: Something went wrong. Try again in a moment.

sessions.title: Your sessions
sessions.intro: The devices and browsers currently signed in to your account.
sessions.endEverywhereHint: Ends every session, including this one. You will need to sign in again.

privacy.breachBody: If your data is lost or exposed in a way that could affect you, we tell you within seventy-two hours of learning of it. That is a limit and not a schedule: if we understand what happened on the first morning, you hear from us that morning. One clock, for everybody, wherever you are.
privacy.heldBasis: The first two rest on your consent, given when you accepted your invitation. The last three rest on our legitimate interest in keeping your account secure, the hall accurate, and what it shows you worth your time.
privacy.heldIdentity: Your name and e-mail address, so a named person can be given access to company reporting.
privacy.heldReads: Which documents you have opened, and when, so the hall can show you what is new and record which version of a deck you were shown. This is yours alone: it is never aggregated, never reported as analytics, and it goes when your account goes.
privacy.heldRole: Your role and the state of your account, so the hall knows what you may read.
privacy.heldSessions: Your last sign-in and your open sessions, so you and an administrator can see them and end them.
privacy.heldType: Whether we have recorded you as having invested or as still deciding, so the hall can put first what you came for. It orders the page and never changes which documents you may read.
privacy.intro: VALO Tech holds a short list of things about the people who read its investor reporting. This page says what, why, how long, and what you can ask us for.
privacy.keptBackups: Encrypted backups are kept for up to twelve months, so somebody deleted today can still appear in a backup taken before that. Those backups are opened only to recover from data loss, never to look a person up.
privacy.keptBody: As long as you have access. Deleting an account is a real deletion: the rows go, not a flag on them.
privacy.rightsAccess: A copy of what we hold about you.
privacy.rightsCorrection: A correction, if something is wrong.
privacy.rightsObjection: To tell us to stop recording what you open. We stop, and we delete what is already there; your account keeps working, but the hall can no longer mark what is new, so everything looks unread.
privacy.rightsPortability: Your data as a file a machine can read, if you want to take it elsewhere. We send you the file itself, never a link to fetch it.
privacy.rightsWithdrawal: To withdraw your consent, which means deleting your account, because access is the only thing your data is here for.
privacy.title: How this hall handles your data
privacy.whereBody: VALO Tech is a Singapore company, and your data is ours to look after. It reaches only two others: the company whose servers we run it on, and the carrier that delivers our e-mail.
privacy.whereTransfer: So it may rest in a country other than the one you are in. Wherever it rests, it goes nowhere without a written agreement binding whoever receives it to the protection it has here: standard contractual clauses, in the ordinary case.

invitationMail.subject: An invitation to the VALO Tech investor hall
invitationMail.intro: {inviter} has invited you to the VALO Tech investor hall, where the company publishes its reporting to the people who have invested in it.
invitationMail.action: Open this link to choose a password and sign in:
invitationMail.expiry: The link can be used once, and it stops working after {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}.
invitationMail.ignore: If you were not expecting this, you can ignore this message. Nothing happens until the link is opened.

resetMail.subject: Reset your VALO Tech password
resetMail.intro: Somebody asked to reset the password for this address at the VALO Tech investor hall.
resetMail.action: If that was you, open this link to choose a new password:
resetMail.expiry: The link can be used once, and it stops working after {hours, plural, one {# hour} other {# hours}}.
resetMail.ignore: If that was not you, your password has not changed and there is nothing you need to do.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.intro: Enter your email address. If an account uses it, a link for choosing a new password is sent there.
forgot.sent: If an account uses that address, a link is on its way. It can be used once and stops working after an hour.
forgot.tooManyAttempts: Too many attempts. Wait a moment and try again.
forgot.unexpected: Something went wrong. Try again in a moment.
forgot.unavailable: Resetting your own password is unavailable at the moment. Ask the person who invited you to the hall.

mailPreference.title: Investor mail
mailPreference.confirmIntro: Stop investor mail to this account? One press is all it takes, and you do not need to sign in.
mailPreference.stops: This stops investor updates — the messages VALO Tech sends to everyone with access to the investor hall.
mailPreference.keeps: It does not stop the messages you need in order to use your account: an invitation, a password reset, or a notice about a message sent to you. Those answer something you or an administrator asked for, so they still reach you.
mailPreference.stopped: Investor mail is stopped for this account.
mailPreference.stoppedByCompany: VALO Tech stopped investor mail to this account. If you start it again and messages still do not arrive, ask the person who invited you.
mailPreference.on: Investor mail is reaching this account.
mailPreference.hallIntro: Whether VALO Tech's investor updates reach the address on your account.
mailPreference.expired: This link no longer works. Sign in to change the setting on your account page, or ask the person who invited you.
